lang_en:
My boss signed my Tawang leave. Then I had to go back.
December. Work handed over.
My out of office was ready.
She paused.
Are we sure about December?
I said it's signed. We're sure.
NakshIQ's answer: Tawang in December, skip.
Two out of ten.
November: go. Eight out of ten.
November was next month.
Your boss, your problem, she said.
My boss moved it to November.
I owe him a weekend.
A signed form isn't travel intelligence.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
बॉस ने मेरी तवांग की छुट्टी साइन कर दी। फिर मुझे दोबारा उनके पास जाना पड़ा।
दिसंबर। काम भी हैंडओवर हो चुका था।
आउट ऑफ़ ऑफ़िस मेल भी तैयार था।
वो रुक गई।
दिसंबर पक्का ठीक है?
मैंने कहा, छुट्टी साइन हो चुकी है। पक्का।
NakshIQ का जवाब: दिसंबर में तवांग, स्किप।
दस में से दो।
नवंबर: गो। दस में से आठ।
नवंबर तो अगला ही महीना था।
वो बोली, बॉस तुम्हारे, प्रॉब्लम भी तुम्हारी।
बॉस ने छुट्टी नवंबर में कर दी।
बदले में, एक वीकेंड उनका उधार है।
साइन किया हुआ फ़ॉर्म, ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस नहीं होता।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: My boss signed my Tawang leave. | Then I *had to go back*.

shots: s1: Evening, their living room. He walks in holding a folded sheet of paper up like a trophy; she sits on the sofa with a laptop. (covers lines 1-2)
s2: He drops onto the sofa beside her and snaps his own laptop shut with a satisfied nod; her hand stops above her trackpad. (covers lines 3-4)
s3: She turns to him, unsure; he waves the folded paper, confident. (covers lines 5-6)
s4: Both look at her laptop, screen turned away from camera; his smile drops. (covers lines 7-10)
s5: She holds out his phone and points at the balcony door, eyebrows raised; he takes it, defeated. (covers line 11)
s6: On the balcony, same evening, he paces with the phone to his ear, then nods slowly; behind the glass door she watches, grinning. (covers lines 12-15)
